cultivation.title: Fights sized to the player who arrives
cultivation.summary: The refit, from the first players' feedback: they reached Regions 5-9 and the Foundation and Golden Core tribulations far stronger than the game expected - pills, Cores, gear, achievements and Samsara were never in the player model - so those fights asked almost nothing.

cultivation.title: A save that cannot be lost, and a clipboard that works
cultivation.summary: A save could be lost: if the game could not read it (after a crash, say), it started a new game, and the first autosave wrote over the old one. No balance changes.

jp-subs.title: Ollama health check
jp-subs.summary: Ollama is a separate program people close, and the old failure mode was to start a run, extract the whole transcript, and only then hit the model call and die. The popup now probes before anything starts and disables Translate until the backend is actually usable.

jp-subs.title: Korean translation
jp-subs.summary: Step 3, and Korean now translates. Its quality has not been checked by a Korean reader, and the popup says so rather than presenting Korean and Japanese as equally trustworthy.

whisper-subs.title: A new window, line-shift check and streaming audio
whisper-subs.summary: The window has been rebuilt as a modern app, with file cards that show each stage's progress, switches instead of checkboxes, and a drop target that covers the whole window.

whisper-subs.title: Desktop app
whisper-subs.summary: A drag-and-drop window for anyone who would rather not use a terminal, and a standalone Windows build that needs no Python installed.

webnovel.title: First release
webnovel.summary: The same extension as 0.5.0, released. What it does:

webnovel.title: Second site, fallbacks
webnovel.summary:
Jinjiang (jjwxc.net free chapters). Its paragraphs are loose text between `
`s, not elements, which exposed Qidian assumptions in the content script. The adapter contract now hands over text nodes and a content root (§5.2).

macroui.title: Hotkeys on/off
macroui.summary: A toggle in the window and the tray menu switches all hotkeys off, so the keys reach other apps normally without stopping macros that are already running. The setting is remembered between launches.

macroui.title: First release
macroui.summary: A dark control panel with Hold Click, Auto Clicker and Hold Keys, plus a Stop all hotkey. Hotkeys are rebindable, including modifier combinations and the mouse side buttons, and the Auto Clicker runs from 0.01 to 1000 clicks per second.
